events.title: Mick Jagger turns 83
events.blurb: Sir Mick Jagger, the iconic frontman of The Rolling Stones, celebrates his 83rd birthday today, July 26th.

angles.name: Rock Legend Still Rolling
angles.copy: Eighty-three years young and still commanding stages worldwide! Wishing a very happy birthday to the legendary Mick Jagger. What's your all-time favourite Stones track?

events.title: MTV launched 45 years ago
events.blurb: Music Television (MTV) first launched on August 1, 1981, with The Buggles' 'Video Killed The Radio Star' famously being the first music video ever aired.

angles.name: Video Killed The Radio Star
angles.copy: Forty-five years ago today, MTV burst onto our screens, forever changing the music landscape. And the very first video? The Buggles' iconic 'Video Killed The Radio Star'. The irony isn't lost on us, but what an era it began!

events.title: Oasis' 'Definitely Maybe' turns 32
events.blurb: Oasis released their seminal debut album 'Definitely Maybe' on August 5, 1994, which quickly became a cornerstone of the Britpop movement.

angles.name: Britpop Royalty Debut
angles.copy: Thirty-two years since Oasis dropped 'Definitely Maybe' and changed everything. From 'Supersonic' to 'Live Forever', this album is pure Britpop gold. What's your standout track?

events.title: Woodstock Festival 57th anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair took place over three days from August 15-18, 1969, becoming a pivotal moment in music and counterculture history.

angles.name: Three Days of Peace & Music
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago, half a million people gathered for three days of peace, love, and music at Woodstock. An unforgettable moment that defined a generation. Which iconic performance do you wish you'd seen?

events.title: Anniversary of Elvis Presley's death
events.blurb: Today marks 49 years since the passing of Elvis Presley, the 'King of Rock 'n' Roll', who died on August 16, 1977, at the age of 42.

angles.name: Remembering The King
angles.copy: Forty-nine years today, the world lost the King of Rock 'n' Roll, Elvis Presley. He would have been 91. His music and legend live on. What's your favourite Elvis hit?

events.title: 30 years since Tupac Shakur was shot
events.blurb: September 1st, 2026, marks 30 years since Tupac Shakur was tragically shot in a drive-by incident in Las Vegas. He would later die on September 13, 1996.

angles.name: Remembering Tupac
angles.copy: Three decades ago, the music world was rocked by the shooting of Tupac Shakur in Las Vegas. He would have been 55 this year. His powerful lyrics and legacy continue to resonate.

events.title: Anniversary of Jimi Hendrix's death
events.blurb: Today marks 56 years since the passing of guitar icon Jimi Hendrix, who died on September 18, 1970, at the age of 27.

angles.name: Guitar God Remembered
angles.copy: Fifty-six years today since we lost the incomparable Jimi Hendrix. He would have been 84. His revolutionary guitar playing changed music forever. What's your favourite Hendrix riff?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' turns 57
events.blurb: The Beatles released their eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', on September 26, 1969, featuring its iconic zebra crossing cover.

angles.name: Iconic Album Cover & Tracks
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That album cover is as legendary as the tracks inside. Which side do you prefer, one or two?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, the formidable frontwoman of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today, September 7th.

angles.name: Pretenders' Icon Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the rock 'n' roll legend Chrissie Hynde! The voice and force behind The Pretenders, still as cool as ever. What's your favourite Pretenders anthem?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, the distinctive voice of Oasis and a Britpop icon, celebrates his 54th birthday today, September 21st.

angles.name: Mad Fer It Birthday!
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing the rock 'n' roll swagger. What's your favourite Liam moment, musical or otherwise?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' released 51 years ago
events.blurb: John Lennon released his iconic peace anthem 'Imagine' on October 1, 1971, which has since become one of the most celebrated songs in history.

angles.name: Imagine Peace
angles.copy: Fifty-one years ago today, John Lennon gave the world 'Imagine'. A timeless message of peace and unity that still resonates today. What does this song mean to you?

events.title: First iPod released 25 years ago
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the very first iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising portable music and paving the way for digital music players.

angles.name: The Device That Changed Music
angles.copy: Remember life before the iPod? Twenty-five years ago, Apple dropped the original, putting '1,000 songs in your pocket'. What was the first album you loaded onto yours?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: October 5th is celebrated annually as James Bond Day, marking the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: It's James Bond Day! Raise a martini (shaken, not stirred, of course) to 007 and his incredible legacy of action, style, and unforgettable theme tunes. Who's your favourite Bond?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Today would have been the 86th birthday of The Beatles' co-founder John Lennon, born October 9, 1940.

angles.name: Remembering a Visionary
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the visionary artist and peace activist, John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary British comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese, best known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today, October 27th.

angles.name: Comedy Genius Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the utterly brilliant John Cleese! A true titan of British comedy, from Monty Python to Fawlty Towers. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles released their ninth studio album, officially titled 'The Beatles' but widely known as 'The White Album', on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: The Iconic Double Album
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album' – a sprawling, diverse, and utterly essential double LP. From 'Back in the U.S.S.R.' to 'Revolution 9', it's a journey. What's your highlight?
